svg.title: OpenMeet Room: one candidate answer from the invite to the integrity flag

g.text: OpenMeet Room: one candidate answer from the invite to the integrity flag
Media: the server only relays the handshake
Video and audio never pass through room_server.py.
The interviewer's browser sends only speech segments and
candidate video frames to this computer.
Gaze, about 10 times a second and once a second
The candidate speaks (speech cut at pauses)
Started as soon as the question is heard, so
the room model is idle again when follow-ups are needed.
or when the confidence is below 0.35.
Kept words land on the meeting clock.
The answer ends: the interviewer speaks, or presses End answer
Nothing about the answer, flag, score or report is sent
to the candidate's page. The candidate only sees the
call, its status and the join page statement about
